title: Verify generated loads across the European map lookup bank
changes: Add one focused TinyCC comparison of the six original map lookup load instructions against the interpreter. Use the existing authenticated dataset with all five backing spans altered.
validation: Windows build gkmt47rd and Wine _tm3qa43 pass. The 93 direct generated bus requests cover all 100 E537 bytes and both table-edge aliases. Complete state and guest clock match after each instruction. Protected inputs pass and Wine drains.
limitations: The test supplies controlled effective addresses to isolated instructions. Generated dispatch in ordinary play, exact startup caller, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
